name: Baseten Sandboxes
description: Gives each user or project in an agentic app an isolated sandbox to run commands and edit files, through a management API, SDKs, the Baseten CLI, or a per-sandbox MCP server.

skills.name: Manage Sandboxes
skills.description: Creates, lists, updates, and deletes sandboxes through the Management API, the SDKs, the Baseten CLI, or the dashboard.

skills.name: Run Commands
skills.description: Runs commands and background processes in a sandbox, and reads, writes, and edits its files over the sandbox runtime API.

skills.name: Sandbox MCP Server
skills.description: Serves an MCP server at each sandbox's URL, giving MCP clients ready-made tools for running commands and editing files.

skills.name: Sandbox Images
skills.description: Builds versioned sandbox images from a Dockerfile, or starts sandboxes from built-in Baseten images such as Base Image.

skills.name: Previews and Volumes
skills.description: Opens a sandboxed web app through a public or private HTTPS preview URL, and keeps files across sandboxes in volumes.
